title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis Threatens Global Trade, IEA's Birol Says
summary: IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol warns the global economy faces renewed peril if the US-Iran conflict choking the Strait of Hormuz is not resolved within weeks. Just 6 vessels were tracked crossing the strait in an 18-hour window versus 18–22 crossings per day earlier this month.
why: 霍尔木兹通道中断将推高全球能源成本，对消费、交通（携程出行需求）及大宗商品定价形成冲击；石油服务板块短线受益，能源波动率上升利于期权方向性操作。

title: 7月16日收盘：美股收高道指涨150点 谷歌等大型科技股推动股指上扬
summary: 美股周三收高：道指+150.37点(+0.29%)报52658点，纳指+0.62%报26269点，标普500+0.38%报7572.40点。亚马逊、微软、Alphabet均涨约3%，苹果涨4%；6月PPI意外环比下降0.3%，降温通胀令市场降低对美联储加息预期。
why: 美股科技板块普涨、PPI超预期降温，整体风险偏好改善；但半导体板块逆势承压，sell put在科技名单存在浮盈需注意delta调整。

title: Micron Drops 8% on China Competition Fears, Dragging Intel, AMD, and Marvell
summary: Micron (MU) shares fell 8% to $903.50 as Chinese DRAM maker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed for an $8.55 billion IPO — set to become the world's fourth-largest DRAM producer — and reports surfaced that Apple is testing CXMT chips for China-market devices. Intel, AMD, and Marvell fell 6–7% in sympathy.
why: CXMT冲击令存储定价权受损叙事实质化，MU/SNDK均为持仓或关注标的；同时AMD/INTC连带下跌，可能为期权sell put策略带来正向时间价值机会。

title: Circle Gets OCC Bank Charter; GENIUS Act July 18 Deadline Looms for CRCL
summary: Circle Internet Group received OCC approval to operate as a trust bank ('Circle National Trust'), allowing it to self-custody the cash and Treasury assets backing its $73B USDC directly. The GENIUS Act stablecoin regulatory framework transition period expires July 18, 2026, adding near-term regulatory uncertainty to CRCL.
why: 银行牌照长期利好（自主管理储备，降低第三方风险），但7月18日大限前监管细则落地前CRCL波动率偏高；sell put需注意暗含波动率突变风险。

title: 港股午盘：恒指跌0.47%、科指跌1.42%，油服股逆势涨，中概股普涨名创优品涨逾9%
summary: 港股早盘走势分化：恒生指数跌0.47%，科技指数跌1.42%，科网股及芯片股普跌；石油服务股受美伊冲突推动油价上涨而逆势强势。美国上市中概股（港股通方向）普涨，名创优品涨超9%，哔哩哔哩涨超5%。
why: 港股科技与大盘同步受压，但中概股结构性走强，可关注持有的港股标的（腾讯、美团等）是否受波及；油服板块受益于地缘危机。

title: Intel Foundry Hits 85% Yield, Winning Chip Orders From AMD, Nvidia, OpenAI as ASML Validates High-NA EUV
summary: Intel's 18A process node yield improved from ~65% to 85%, surpassing the commercial viability threshold, backed by ASML validation of Intel as the first company shipping high-volume chips via High-NA EUV. Design wins from AMD, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Apple were reported; Intel stock rose 4.5% with KeyBanc upgrading to Overweight, target $155.
why: 18A良率突破是英特尔代工业务的关键里程碑，将重估晶圆代工市场格局；INTC估值向上修正概率增大，7月23日财报为下一催化剂——sell put策略可考虑在业绩前布局。

title: SK Hynix Posts Worst Seoul Session on Record as HBM Contracts Limit Earnings Upside
summary: SK Hynix fell 15.4% on July 13 — its worst single-session decline on record — after Korea Investment & Securities revised its Q2 blended DRAM ASP growth estimate from 50% quarter-on-quarter to 28.9%, citing HBM long-term contracts that cap near-term upside. SK Hynix's 2026 HBM supply is fully sold out.
why: SK海力士港股相关联产品（南方两倍做多等）受波及；HBM合约定价限制意味着下半年业绩弹性或低于预期，与美光CXMT冲击形成共振，存储赛道短期风险上升。

title: Tesla Expands Unsupervised Robotaxi to Miami; Q2 Delivered ~480,000 Vehicles; Earnings July 22
summary: Tesla launched its unsupervised Robotaxi service in Miami (July 5), the second US city after Austin, with Cybercab engineering tests also running. Q2 2026 deliveries totalled ~480,000 vehicles (452,000 produced) and energy storage hit 13.5 GWh — both ahead of estimates — with Q2 earnings scheduled July 22.
why: Robotaxi商业化提速叠加Q2超预期交付，为7月22日财报提供正面预期；若结合FSD收入确认，EPS上修空间显著，这是已有TSLA持仓或sell put的关键日历事件。

title: Tencent HY3 Tops OpenRouter Charts: 6.13 Trillion Tokens Weekly, Surpassing DeepSeek V4 and Xiaomi MiMo
summary: Tencent's Hunyuan Hy3 (a 295B MoE open model released July 6) claimed #1 on OpenRouter's weekly LLM usage leaderboard with 6.13 trillion tokens processed, surpassing Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 and DeepSeek V4 Flash. The free-tier offer drove the surge; Hy3 shows leading performance in coding and agentic tasks.
why: 腾讯AI大模型竞争力显著提升，混元Hy3的全球调用量第一是重要里程碑，可提升腾讯云AI业务收入预期；这也强化了0700.HK在AI赛道的估值叙事。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) Breaks $1,500 Support on China NAND Competition Fears; Shares Down 5.7%
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell 5.71% on July 15, breaching the critical $1,500 support level amid the same Chinese memory competition worries driving Micron lower. SNDK is now down 28% from its 52-week high despite year-to-date gains of 508%; the stock is tied to NAND pricing dynamics with Kioxia joint fab operations also under scrutiny.
why: 闪迪与美光同受中国NAND产能威胁冲击，两者均为关注名单标的；SNDK期权隐含波动率或上升，短期sell put需谨慎对待支撑破位后的进一步下探风险。

title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Q1 2026 Revenue $109.9B, Google Cloud +63% YoY; Q2 Earnings Due July 22
summary: Alphabet Q1 2026 posted revenue of $109.9 billion, net income +81% to $62.6B, and EPS of $5.11. Google Cloud grew 63% year-on-year, its fastest rate in years. Q2 2026 earnings are expected around July 22, with analyst consensus EPS of ~$2.87. Alphabet shares rose ~3% on July 15 amid the broader tech rally.
why: 谷歌Q1业绩强劲，云业务+63%说明AI需求旺盛；Q2财报7月22日临近，是当周最大催化事件，对英伟达/英特尔代工需求背书也具参考价值。

title: Circle Faces July 18 GENIUS Act Test as CRCL Stock Risks Fresh Slide
summary: With the GENIUS Act's one-year regulatory transition period expiring July 18, Circle (CRCL) and Coinbase face heightened volatility as the Fed, Treasury, OCC, and other agencies are expected to release final stablecoin implementation guidance. US banking groups have already lobbied for changes to the companion CLARITY Act, and Baird lowered its CRCL target to $100.
why: 7月18日是稳定币监管落地的关键节点，细则若严苛（更高资本要求/限制收益）将直接压制CRCL估值；若温和则提振信心，是近两日最大事件驱动风险点。
